dedupe_keys.name: 3d data of prague geoportal praha ipr praha building and bridge model terrain and surface models photorealistic mesh and digital twin

description: The Prague Institute of Planning and Development (IPR Praha) publishes 3D data of Prague through the Geoportal Praha, describing spatial models of the terrain, buildings and vegetation that are used, for example, to visualise planned buildings or to analyse the urban environment. The '3D data of Prague' category lists a model of buildings and bridges (a basic 3D model of the built-up area), a digital terrain model (surface without vegetation and buildings), a digital surface model (with vegetation and other objects), a photorealistic model or 3D mesh, and Prague's digital twin, described as an important city project of recent years; satellite images used to monitor vegetation and summer heat sit next to it. Coverage: the City of Prague. The geoportal also offers a digital technical map, orthophotos, map services, an open data section and an e-výdej download service. Format and access: dataset pages on geoportalpraha.cz; formats, download routes and prices were not read, because the individual metadata pages returned 'metadata not found' when read from the cloud. Licence: not read; the site footer states all rights reserved for the website. Caveats: only the category listing was read; which products are open data and which are sold was not established. Simulation uses: city-scale building, bridge and terrain geometry for flood, heat and emergency response studies and for a municipal digital twin. Related records: Prague Integrated Transport open data (data-prague-pid-open-data) and the Golemio data platform (data-golemio-prague-open-api-waste-and-city-services) cover the same city.
